User.title: User
User.description: Student user profile information with USN and academic branch details

usn.description: University Seat Number or student registration ID

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was last modified

Deadline.title: Deadline
Deadline.description: Academic deadline, assignment, project submission, or lab evaluation task

id.description: Unique identifier for the deadline item

taskName.description: Name or title of the academic deadline task

description.description: Optional notes or instructions for the deadline

dueTime.description: Optional due time in 24-hour HH:mm format

importance.description: Calculated priority level of the task

completed.description: Whether the deadline task has been marked as finished

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the deadline was registered

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the deadline was last updated

source.description: Source origin of the deadline record

sourceId.description: Reference identifier of the source document or notice

dateSource.description: Provenance of the assigned deadline date

timetableDerived.description: Whether the date was inferred from the timetable context engine

TimetableEntry.title: TimetableEntry
TimetableEntry.description: Weekly recurring timetable class or laboratory session

id.description: Unique identifier for the timetable schedule entry

startTime.description: Class start time in 24h format e.g. 09:00

endTime.description: Class end time in 24h format e.g. 10:00

room.description: Lecture hall, laboratory room number, or classroom

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this timetable block was added

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this timetable block was last edited

SourceDocument.title: SourceDocument
SourceDocument.description: Uploaded academic document, syllabus, circular notice, or timetable image

storagePath.description: Firebase Cloud Storage object reference path

extractedDeadlinesCount.description: Number of deadlines identified by AI in this notice

uploadedAt.description: Timestamp when the document was uploaded

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Student customizable preferences and display configurations

notificationReminders.description: Whether deadline alert notifications are activated

radarWindowDays.description: Number of lookahead days for Academic Radar

pomodoroFocusMinutes.description: Duration in minutes for Focus Now session timer

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when settings were last modified

NotificationToken.title: NotificationToken
NotificationToken.description: FCM device registration token for future academic push notifications

lastUsedAt.description: Timestamp of most recent push delivery

Exam.title: Exam
Exam.description: Scheduled exam record for the student

CalendarEvent.title: CalendarEvent
CalendarEvent.description: User-specific calendar event across academic, sports, personal, and other categories

RegisteredUser.title: RegisteredUser
RegisteredUser.description: Public directory entry used for account verification across Sign In and Create Account tabs

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the registered student

DailyPlan.title: DailyPlan
DailyPlan.description: Generated or saved daily schedule plan for the student

/registeredUsers/{emailKey}.description: Directory of registered DeadlineIQ user emails to verify account existence before granting access

/users/{uid}.description: Student user profile documents indexed by Firebase Auth UID

/users/{uid}/deadlines/{deadlineId}.description: Academic tasks and assignments belonging strictly to the authenticated student

/users/{uid}/timetable/{timetableId}.description: Weekly course timetable records belonging strictly to the authenticated student

/users/{uid}/exams/{examId}.description: Scheduled examination records belonging strictly to the authenticated student

/users/{uid}/events/{eventId}.description: User-specific calendar events belonging strictly to the authenticated student

/users/{uid}/sources/{sourceId}.description: Metadata for source notices and PDFs processed by AI

/users/{uid}/notificationTokens/{tokenId.description: Push notification device tokens registered for the student

/users/{uid}/dailyPlans/{planId}.description: Daily schedule plans belonging strictly to the authenticated student
